title_en: One bitcoin costs that much. Can I still buy some?
title_zh: 一枚比特币太贵，我就不能买吗？
goal_en: Tell the number of coins apart from the amount you spend, and know bitcoin can be bought in fractions.
goal_zh: 能区分币的数量与购买金额，知道比特币可拆分购买。

shots.visual_en: Sam looks up at a giant bitcoin price board; the coin purse in Sam's hand shrinks to a dot. Logo mark + wordmark already top-left.
shots.visual_zh: 小白抬头看巨大的比特币价格牌，自己的零钱袋缩成一点；画面左上角已有标志。

lines.en: One coin costs that much? I can't even afford a ticket in.
lines.zh: 一枚这么贵，我的钱是不是连门票都买不起？

shots.visual_en: Brand open (3 s): official NexuAlpha logo mark + wordmark (imported SVG, never redrawn, proportions locked) eases in centre-left; series title, 'S1 · E01' and the episode title slide in beside it; fixed short brand sting. Nexubo pops up from the bottom edge with a squash-and-stretch landing, antenna blue.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片头（3秒）：正式标志图形＋文字标（导入原始SVG，不重画、不变比例）淡入；旁边显示系列名、“第1季 · 第01集”与本集标题；固定短音效。小纳从画面下沿弹出落地，天线蓝灯。
onscreen_text_en: One bitcoin costs that much. Can I still buy some?
onscreen_text_zh: 一枚比特币太贵，我就不能买吗？

shots.visual_en: Nexubo pulls a quantity ruler out of one whole coin: 1, 0.1, 0.01, 0.001. It is a scale, not a coin being cut into physical pieces.
shots.visual_zh: 小纳把整枚币的数量刻度拉开，显示1、0.1、0.01、0.001；不是切成实体硬币。

lines.en: That's the price of one whole coin. It's not what you have to pay each time. Bitcoin is a digital asset, and you can hold it in decimal amounts. You usually don't buy a whole one.
lines.zh: 你看到的是一整枚的价格，不是每次必须支付的金额。比特币是一种数字资产，可以按小数数量持有，通常不用一次买一整枚。

shots.visual_en: Teaching quote locked at 50,000 USDT. 100 ÷ 50,000 animates into 0.002 BTC. Label 'teaching assumption' stays on screen.
shots.visual_zh: 教学报价固定为50,000 USDT，100除以50,000，变成0.002 BTC。

lines.en: One practice sum. Say one bitcoin is 50,000 USDT and you spend 100. Ignoring fees, that's 0.002 bitcoin. This is not today's market price.
lines.zh: 只做一道假设题：一枚值五万单位泰达币，成交金额是一百，忽略费用，就对应零点零零二枚比特币。这不是今天的市场报价。

onscreen_text_en: Teaching assumption · not a live price or real platform rate
onscreen_text_zh: 教学假设 · 非实时行情，非平台真实费率

shots.visual_en: Two ledger columns: 'Quantity 0.002' and 'Value changes with price'; the value column moves up and down while quantity stays fixed.
shots.visual_zh: 两列账本分别写“数量0.002”和“估值随价格变化”，估值上下变动。

lines.en: The number of coins can stay the same, but their value goes up and down. Buying a little means risking less. It doesn't mean no risk.
lines.zh: 你持有的数量可以不变，折合价值却会涨，也会跌。买得少，只是投入少，不等于没有风险。

shots.visual_en: Two sign boards, 'Minimum order' and 'Fees', block the confirm button. A 'Virtual funds' badge on the balance.
shots.visual_zh: “最小下单金额”“手续费”两个提示牌挡在确认按钮前。

lines.en: You can split it, but not every platform accepts any tiny order. Check the minimum amount and the fees. While you learn, use virtual funds. No deposit needed.
lines.zh: 能拆分，不代表所有平台都接受任意小的订单。还要检查最小金额和费用。学习阶段先用虚拟资金，不需要充值。

shots.visual_en: Quiz card: 'Must buy 1 whole coin' / 'Can buy an allowed decimal amount'. The correct option flips over to show the course stamp.
shots.visual_zh: 选择题：必须买1枚／可按允许的小数数量买；正确项翻出课程印章。

lines.en: Do you have to buy a whole bitcoin? No. Remember: the price of one coin is not the price of getting started.
lines.zh: 购买比特币必须买一整枚吗？不必。记住：整枚的价格，不是入门的门槛。

onscreen_text_en: Can buy an allowed decimal amount
onscreen_text_zh: 可按允许的小数数量买

shots.visual_en: End hook (4 s): quick teaser of the next problem — a single striking image from the next episode's opening, frozen on the moment of doubt; Sam reacts, Nexubo's antenna blinks amber. Text card with the hook line.
shots.visual_zh: 片尾钩子（4秒）：下一集开场矛盾的一个定格画面，停在“犯疑问”的瞬间；小白反应，小纳天线琥珀灯闪。字卡显示钩子台词。

lines.en: Most trades are priced in USDT. But is USDT really a dollar? Next episode.
lines.zh: 大多数交易都用USDT标价。可它真的是美元吗？下一集揭晓。

onscreen_text_en: Most trades are priced in USDT. But is USDT really a dollar? Next episode.
onscreen_text_zh: 大多数交易都用USDT标价。可它真的是美元吗？下一集揭晓。

shots.visual_en: Branded close (4 s): logo mark + wordmark lockup, series name, tagline 'Understand first, then act.', small slogan line 'One verified gateway to the world's exchanges', 'nexualpha.com' as plain text (the clickable entry lives on the web page). Nexubo waves, antenna green.
shots.visual_zh: 品牌片尾（4秒）：标志图形＋文字标、系列名、“先看懂，再动手。”、小号品牌标语“全球交易所，一个官方入口”；“nexualpha.com”为识别文字（可点击入口在网页）。小纳挥手，天线绿灯。
onscreen_text_en: One verified gateway to the world's exchanges
onscreen_text_zh: 全球交易所，一个官方入口

end_hook.en: Most trades are priced in USDT. But is USDT really a dollar? Next episode.
end_hook.zh: 大多数交易都用USDT标价。可它真的是美元吗？下一集揭晓。

page_cta.line_en: Minimum order sizes and fees differ by exchange. Check them side by side on NexuAlpha.
page_cta.line_zh: 各交易所的最小下单金额和费用不同，到 NexuAlpha 对比页并排查看。
page_cta.placement: directly beside / under the video player; never gates the lesson

exercise.task_en: In the practice panel, convert a spend of 100 into a coin amount. No real order is created.
exercise.task_zh: 在模拟页面把成交金额100换算成币数量；不创建真实订单。

red_lines: Label the teaching price on screen; never show live prices ｜ 画面注明教学假设价，不展示实时行情
Never promise that every exchange accepts 100 or 10-dollar orders ｜ 不得承诺所有交易所支持100或10美元起购
Logo mark + wordmark top-left on every shot, official SVG only ｜ 每个镜头左上角都有正式标志图形＋文字标，只用原始SVG
